category.instructions: Choose the kind of note the summary describes. Judge by what the summary records, not by any folder name written inside it.

criteria.Projects: The summary describes a multi-session effort as a whole: its goal, scope, status, or the decisions that shape it.
criteria.Sessions: The summary is the working state of one unit of work in progress: what was done, what is next, where to resume.
criteria.Tasks: The summary describes work planned but not started, written so someone can pick it up later.
criteria.MOCs: The summary describes a whole domain and how its notes relate, as a hub over many notes.
criteria.root: The summary is a standalone piece of knowledge, such as a decision, root cause, incident, pattern, or reference, that belongs to none of the above.

moc.instructions: Choose the Map of Content whose domain best matches the subject of the summary. Judge by the topic the summary describes.

criteria.MOC - Agent Memory: Vault-as-memory tooling, hooks, and the judge.
